published_candidates.name: الغزااوي | الحجز التلقائي
published_candidates.note: v1.0.12: reservations you make by hand (listed under your name in the tribe reservation list) are now detected and recorded in "My reservations" (marked manual, never auto-replaced); stricter own-name matching. v1.0.11: bare /barb (from the bot command menu) opens the control menu. v1.0.10: honest Telegram-window messages (non-leader/stopped/other-tab cases), closing the window reverts a Telegram LIVE, local mode changes no longer trigger a false expiry notice, expiry enforced at the mutation gate. v1.0.9: opt-in time-limited window to enable LIVE from Telegram (opened locally with confirmation, one tab, 1-12h, then /live + inline confirm; auto-reverts to preview). v1.0.8: Telegram replies to alerts: «حجز» (reserves the last alerted barb, needs LIVE confirmed in the tab) and «تجاهل» (silences it for a week), plus buttons. v1.0.7: new «تنبيه فقط» mode: searches automatically and sends a Telegram message with a direct village link; never reserves, replaces or releases. v1.0.6: confirmed LIVE mode survives page reloads in the same tab (every page load used to reset to preview and stop the script); new tabs still start in preview. v1.0.5: one-button Telegram linking per subscriber via the site bot (needs migration 2026-11-03-barb-per-user.sql and a Pages deploy; owner key path unchanged). v1.0.4: settings trimmed to 20 essentials in three groups, profiles/import-export moved under advanced, day/night automatic profile switching removed. v1.0.3: panel tabs wrap in two rows and never disappear when settings open; settings reduced to essentials with the rest under a collapsed advanced section. v1.0.2: fix settings save that silently reverted the preview checkbox (now follows the same guarded confirm path as the main toggle). v1.0.1 integrates source 0.10.1 diagnostics with Barb Control relay. Tampermonkey GM secret storage, no BotFather token, real reservations require local DRY_RUN opt-in and live-game verification.
